brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued raids on the village of Kafr Nama west of Ramallah on Wednesday in preparation for demolishing the homes of detained Palestinians Ibrahim Abu Adi and Abdullah al-Khatib, the Ma'an news agency reported.

The demolitions are among a series of punitive measures Israeli authorities have pursued against families of Palestinians in detention. The two men's homes are located in the village, which has faced repeated military incursions in recent months.
title: Israeli forces raid Kafr Nama ahead of demolishing prisoners' homes
